cohortDefinitions.scope: Brand-specific front-load or top-load washer cohorts only
checks: Stop the cycle and wait for the door/lid lock indicator to clear.
Remove clothing or debris caught at the visible door/lid edge.
Wipe only the visible latch/strike contact area with a soft damp cloth.
Close the door/lid firmly once; do not force it or bypass the lock.
exclusions: Front-load gasket steps do not apply to top-load lids
Do not bypass, force, or replace a lock
cohortDefinitions.exceptionRule: Exact manual wins; absent a brand/topology source, remain unsupported.

checks: Confirm dishes, handles, and utensils stay inside the rack envelope.
Push both racks fully home and remove visible debris at the door seal.
Check for visible cabinet or countertop interference without loosening hardware.
Close the door once; do not force the latch.
exclusions: AutoRelease/open-dry branches only on equipped models
cohortDefinitions.exceptionRule: Use model-prefix and feature gates stated by the manufacturer.

cohortDefinitions.scope: Brand-specific full-size refrigerator cohorts, split by side-by-side and French-door topology
checks: Move food packages, bins, drawers, or shelves that block closure.
Wipe visible gasket soil with a soft cloth and mild soapy water.
Check only the topology-specific mullion/flap position when the source and model support it.
Close the door gently and observe whether it stays shut.
exclusions: French-door mullion step not used on side-by-side models
cohortDefinitions.exceptionRule: Model manual confirms flap/mullion, drawer, showcase-door, and leveling branches.
